principle: A many-voiced public record preserves attribution, duration, qualification, and disagreement without converting coalition testimony into Jamie's sole authorship.

criteria.description: The corpus covers each of the seven Council hearings in the recovered Jamie testimony and Commercial Rent Stabilization inventory.
Every event is bound to an official Council transcript URL and a source-text digest.
Every included contribution records a canonical display name, official speaker label, role, position, issue scope, and full recovered turns.
Support, qualified support, aligned opposition to a mechanism, and aligned non-position remain distinct.
Unselected transcript labels remain visible in a coverage ledger rather than disappearing.
The derived corpus removes page furniture but does not silently correct official transcript wording or apparent errors.
Direct email addresses and telephone numbers are absent from the public corpus.
The official Council transcript remains identified as the canonical complete event record.
Inclusion never implies sole authorship, universal agreement, or independent verification of testimony claims.
Generated event records are reproducible from the governed corpus and current with it.
Speaker identity and position classifications remain reviewable editorial judgments, not automated publication authority.
Supportive public officials are retained with their public role and exact issue scope; public office is never treated as blanket endorsement.
